scope: Every subset of the six-bit Hamming space with pairwise distance at least four has a vertex farther than two from every center. No linearity or cardinality hypothesis. Graph shortest-path semantics, the packing cardinality bound and the complete strong-product affine theorem are written mathematics, not formalized by this source.
